source_title: 'Titans' BO day 9: Jayasurya and Vinayakan's film collects Rs 2.65 cr
source_excerpt: Jayasurya and Vinayakan's fantasy film 'Titans' has completed nine days in theatres with a total India net collection of Rs 2.65 cr. Its domestic gross earnings have reached Rs 3.07 cr, according to Sacnilk. The film collected Rs 10 lakh on Friday, October 30, from 321 shows across the country. Its latest performance reflects a continued slowdown after the opening weekend.The film had started its theatrical run with a promising collection but struggled to maintain that momentum during the weekdays. It recorded a brief improvement over its first weekend before its daily earnings began falling. The latest figures also indicate a reduction in its show count, with the film receiving fewer screenings than it had during its opening days.'Titans' records Rs 10 lakh on Day 9'Titans' earned Rs 65 lakh on its opening day, followed by Rs 35 lakh on Friday. Its collections improved over the weekend, with Saturday contributing Rs 43 lakh and Sunday adding Rs 52 lakh. However, the film's earnings declined again from Monday onwards.The film collected Rs 10 lakh on its second Friday, marking a 9.1% drop from the previous day's Rs 11 lakh. Its occupancy improved slightly from Thursday's 9% to 11%. However, the number of shows fell from 480 to 321.First-week collection stands at Rs 2.55 crThe film accumulated Rs 2.55 cr in India net collections during its first eight days. The corresponding gross collection stood at Rs 2.95 cr. Its opening weekend provided the strongest contribution, but the subsequent weekday figures remained relatively low.The day-wise trend shows that the film's best performance came on its opening day. Sunday also recorded a healthy collection compared with the preceding day. The sharpest decline occurred on Monday, when the film's earnings dropped by 59.6% from the previous day's total.'Jailer 2' maintains its box office dominanceMeanwhile, Rajinikanth's action drama 'Jailer 2' continues to perform strongly in theatres, including in Kerala. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the sequel has accumulated Rs 776.95 cr in worldwide gross collections after 16 days. It is now approaching the Rs 800 cr milestone.The film has also moved significantly ahead of the worldwide collection of its 2023 predecessor, 'Jailer'. The difference between the two films at the same stage has crossed Rs 240 cr. However, 'Jailer 2' witnessed a decline in its latest domestic earnings compared with the previous day. On its 16th day, 'Jailer 2' collected Rs 5.50 cr net in India from 8,079 shows. Its cumulative domestic net earnings reached Rs 435.40 cr, while the India gross collection stood at Rs 509.45 cr.The film added Rs 3 cr in overseas gross collections on Friday. This took its cumulative international earnings to Rs 267.50 cr. The combined domestic and overseas business has brought its worldwide gross collection to Rs 776.95 cr, according to Sacnilk.What is the story of 'Titans'?'Titans' follows Antony Yakuza and his roommate Anwar, who plan one final job in Fort Kochi to earn respect. Their attempt takes an unexpected turn when Rejimon, the getaway driver, brings his own secret agenda into the operation. The plan soon spirals into an unpredictable sequence of events involving crime, mystery and fantasy.Jayasurya and Vinayakan headline the film.
